title: Board card 'Effective Might' badge ignores meta.extraBuffs, so Lee Sin's 'any number of buffs' stacking is not reflected in the UI.
expected: apps/riftbound-app/public/js/gameplay/render/card.js:219-220 computes effMight = baseMight + mightModifier + staticMightBonus + (meta.buffed ? 1 : 0) + equipmentMightBonus + combatRoleMightBonus, with no extraBuffs term; grep for "extraBuffs" across public/js returns nothing. Engine consistently adds (meta.extraBuffs ?? 0) (e.g. abilities/effects/_helpers.ts:85, target-resolver.ts:774, effects/buff.ts:45 increments extraBuffs on stacked buff). server/snapshot.ts:396 spreads full baseMeta so extraBuffs reaches the client, but the badge ignores it -> shows 6 instead of 7 for Lee Sin's second buff.
observed: public/js/gameplay/render/card.js computes effMight with `(card.meta?.buffed ? 1 : 0)` only; the .card-might badge showed '6' after both the first and the second buff even though state meta was {buffed:true, extraBuffs:1}. (combat.js showdown renderer ignores buffs entirely: base+mightModifier+staticMightBonus.)

history.note: board + showdown Might badges add meta.extraBuffs (stacked buffs)

resolution.note: board + showdown Might badges add meta.extraBuffs (stacked buffs)
